T014 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : WSpace n × ℝ → WTarget m) (q : WTarget m),
  (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (wDensity u) (wDomain n) ∧
      ContinuousOn (wT (wDensity u)) (wDomain n) ∧
        ∀ (x : WSpace n) (t : ℝ),
          0 < t →
            inner ℝ (u (x, t)) (wT u (x, t)) = 0 ∧
              inner ℝ (wT u (x, t)) (wT (wT u) (x, t) - wLap u (x, t)) = 0 ∧
                (∀ (a : ℝ),
                    wT (wT u) (x, t) - wLap u (x, t) = a • u (x, t) →
                      a = ∑ j, ‖wX u j (x, t)‖ ^ 2 - ‖wT u (x, t)‖ ^ 2) ∧
                  (∀ (j : Fin n), wT (wX u j) (x, t) = wX (wT u) j (x, t)) ∧
                    wT (wDensity u) (x, t) = 2 * wA u (x, t) + 2 * ∑ j, wB u j (x, t)) →
    (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => wDensity u (x, t)) volume ∧ ∃ C R B, wLocal u q t C R B) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ),
          0 < t →
            HasDerivAt (wEnergy u) (2 * ∫ (x : WSpace n), inner ℝ (wT u (x, t)) (wT (wT u) (x, t) - wLap u (x, t))) t) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => wDensity u (x, t)) volume ∧ HasDerivAt (wEnergy u) 0 t
